reviews.comment: He was a graduate student when I took his class. Very likable and knowledgeable professor. The material was not the most difficult and he was very understanding when it came to assignments.

Bullard's a great professor who wants to see his students succeed in the course. The class is very tough but he provides plenty of extra credit opportunities. Bullard is a great lecturer and keeps the class awake and entertained. Highly recommend Professor. Bullard for this course.

Aside from Public Finc (412) - Maxwell was a decent professor, however I do think that the class should be considered a graduate class. Class is mandatary if you want to access the PowerPoint slides (password for slides). Two Exams that are problem set-heavy along with problem sets that take on average 2hrs to complete.

Prof. Bullard is definitely best graduate professor I have ever had. He has a charisma that keeps his classes entertaining, and although teaching method is very much sink or swim he is forgiving on exams and is very willing to help if you have questions. Had a final project but it was relatively simple and was done in groups of 4-5.
